data_cases.question: Show qualcomm FY2024 and FY2025 consolidated GAAP revenue, gross profit, operating income, and operating cash flow with exact USD values and sources. then compare the two years numbers
data_cases.answer:
- Qualcomm consolidated US GAAP figures, in exact USD:
  - Revenue: FY2024 $38,962,000,000 [F1]; FY2025 $44,284,000,000 [F5].
  - Gross profit: FY2024 $21,902,000,000 [F2]; FY2025 $24,546,000,000 [F6].
  - Operating income: FY2024 $10,071,000,000 [F3]; FY2025 $12,355,000,000 [F7].
  - Operating cash flow: FY2024 $12,202,000,000 [F4]; FY2025 $14,012,000,000 [F8].

- FY2025 versus FY2024:
  - Revenue increased 13.66% [C1].
  - Gross profit increased 12.07% [C2].
  - Operating income increased 22.68%, outpacing revenue growth [C3][C1].
  - Operating cash flow increased 14.83% [C4].
  - Gross margin declined from 56.21% to 55.43% [C5][C6].
  - Operating margin improved from 25.85% to 27.90% [C7][C8].

- Periods and qualifications:
  - FY2024: September 25, 2023–September 29, 2024; 53 weeks [F1].
  - FY2025: September 30, 2024–September 28, 2025; 52 weeks [F5].
  - Comparisons use original-report figures, without week-count normalization.
  - Gross profit observations are derived as revenue minus cost of revenue, rather than separately tagged reported subtotals [F2][F6].

- Sources:
  - FY2024: [Qualcomm 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/804328/000080432824000075/qcom-20240929.htm), filed November 6, 2024 [F1][F2][F3][F4].
  - FY2025: [Qualcomm 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/804328/000080432825000085/qcom-20250928.htm), filed November 5, 2025 [F5][F6][F7][F8].

- Verified outputs: [CSV table](/api/analysis/592f20fb5a34a205855eb09e9945c609d03e32ab7c8f4077a438599a16aedc6f/files/table.csv) and [PNG chart](/api/analysis/592f20fb5a34a205855eb09e9945c609d03e32ab7c8f4077a438599a16aedc6f/files/chart.png).

data_cases.question: which company had the largest earnings growth from 24 to 25? what is the number
data_cases.answer:
- AMD had the largest FY2024–FY2025 earnings growth: 164.17%, based on original-report consolidated GAAP net income attributable to parent. [C1]
- AMD net income rose from $1.641 billion to $4.335 billion. Fiscal years ended December 28, 2024, and December 27, 2025. [F1][F2]
- NVIDIA grew 144.89%; Qualcomm declined 45.37%. [C2][C3]
- Intel is excluded from percentage ranking because its baseline was a loss: −$18.756 billion in FY2024 versus −$267 million in FY2025. [F3][F4]
- Fiscal periods are not calendar-aligned: NVIDIA’s years ended January 28, 2024/January 26, 2025; Qualcomm’s ended September 29, 2024/September 28, 2025. Qualcomm had 53 versus 52 weeks; no normalization was applied. [F5][F6][F7][F8]
- Verified table and PNG chart are available.
